_comment: Replay-only bootstrap compatibility migrations. They sort before versions already applied on Development because they recreate objects that were created there out of band. Fresh installations run them in order; an installation whose history already contains required_before must record them with 'supabase migration repair --status applied' only after supabase/tests/bootstrap-compat-preflight.sql passes read-only. See docs/MIGRATION_REPLAY_RECONCILIATION_2026-10-18.md.

migrations.name: continuity_rehearsal_schema_recovery
migrations.reason: 20261006100248 alters seven rehearsal tables created only out of band on Development.

migrations.name: audit_pause_legacy_compatibility
migrations.reason: 20261012075338 disables a Development-only audit pause trigger; the shim creates it disabled with a pass-through function so a clean replay can run that statement. 20261018103000 then removes it.
